note: Community offers for the public perks page. Confirmed and approved entries have terms we can state, and none are claimable from this page: codes stay private and unpublished partner links stay out of this file. activation_pending is agreed and not active. terms_pending has an offer in, without confirmed commercial terms. Do not add claim codes, private dashboard URLs, personal contacts, or affiliate links.

perks.headline: 50% off the first six months
perks.one_line: Writes meeting notes and action items.
perks.offer: 50% off the first six months of Circleback for first-time customers.
perks.eligibility: BSTC members who are first-time Circleback customers. No funding required.
perks.claim_status: Claiming is not open. The member code is private while setup is in progress.
perks.notes: Confirmed with Circleback on 28 Oct 2026. The discount applies to the first six months. It is not a flat 50% off after that.

perks.headline: 6 months free, up to $25k
perks.offer: Six months free, up to $25k in free Zendesk per eligible startup.
perks.eligibility: New Zendesk customers with fewer than 250 employees, and no more than Series B funding. Approved for Remote Builders and BSTC as a startup partner.
perks.claim_status: Claiming is not open on this page. Startups apply through the community's unique partner link, and that link is not published here.
perks.notes: Includes Copilot assistance, AI agents with automated resolutions, 10 automated resolutions per agent per month, full API access, up to five help centres, and App Builder access. Approved on 2 Nov 2026. The public Zendesk for Startups programme is listed separately on this page.

perks.headline: 20% off the first payment
perks.one_line: Podcast and video recording at riverside.com.
perks.offer: 20% off the first payment for new customers on monthly or yearly self-serve B2C plans. The Business plan is not included.
perks.eligibility: New Riverside customers. Listed for BSTC members. Remote Builders coverage is not confirmed.
perks.claim_status: The claim route is pending. The partner link and the checkout code are not published here.
perks.notes: Confirmed on 1 Nov 2026. The discount applies to the first payment, not to later invoices. Members should use the partner link before the code, once a link is available.

perks.headline: 50% off annual Basic or Professional
perks.one_line: B2B contact database, prospecting and outreach.
perks.offer: 50% off Basic or Professional annual plans for the first year, up to 5 seats.
perks.eligibility: New customers with a valid business email and 20 or fewer employees. Covers Remote Builders and BSTC.
perks.claim_status: The application link is pending and is not published here.
perks.notes: Confirmed on 29 Oct 2026. Community coverage, including Remote Builders, was confirmed on 30 Oct 2026. A dedicated partner page is not published here. The public Apollo for Startups programme is listed separately on this page.

perks.headline: 20% off the first year
perks.offer: Referred companies get 20% off the first year and waived implementation fees.
perks.eligibility: Companies referred by Remote Builders or BSTC.
perks.claim_status: Referral introduction required before signing. The route is pending, so no contact details are published here.
perks.notes: Confirmed on 30 Oct 2026. Remote Builders coverage was confirmed on 31 Oct 2026. The introduction has to happen before the company signs. It does not apply retroactively. Companies that have raised under $1 million and have 25 or fewer stakeholders get Carta Launch free. The public Carta Launch programme is listed separately on this page.

perks.headline: 20% off the first 3 months
perks.offer: New referred users get 20% off their first 3 months.
perks.eligibility: New users referred through the community partner programme. This is a standard partner programme, not a BSTC-exclusive deal.
perks.claim_status: Apply through the community partner link. The unique link is not published on this page.
perks.notes: Approved on 28 Oct 2026. The partner reward is separate and is not a member benefit.

perks.headline: Extra US$10 on the Starter plan
perks.offer: Extra US$10 of usage on the Starter plan. This is not a percentage discount.
perks.eligibility: The Starter plan, once the offer is activated.
perks.claim_status: Agreed, activation pending. This is not claimable. Any code stays off this page.
perks.notes: Agreed on 3 Nov 2026. Valid until the end of January 2027, with a maximum of 150 redemptions.
